audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page treats Audacity as her one entry — 'once spent she cannot reach you'. That is false and it is the advice a player would die on.
audit.why: Terrashape is a second dash at 1100 range on a flat 7s cooldown, longer than Audacity's 650 at 11/10/9/8/7s. Baiting Audacity does not put you out of reach.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rewritten to name both dashes and both timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 paragraph credited Brand with 'a long-range execute/root' and named her ultimate 'Elementalist Draconic'.
audit.why: Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times and slows ablaze targets — no execute, no root. Her ultimate is Supreme Display of Talent, a flat 120s, 950 range, and it needs an element to detonate.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten with the real ultimate names and effects.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] said 'Hold E (Pillar) to interrupt her E dash or root her mid-animation' — wrong slot, wrong effect, and Brand has no root. mid also credited 'Pillar's stun'.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame is W (900 range, delayed AoE). Brand's only stun is Sear (Q) and only against an already-ablaze target. Nothing in his kit roots.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and mid rewritten onto W for the ground she must cross and Sear for the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number; packet notes the page never names a single Qiyana ability.
audit.why: Audacity 11s->7s, Terrashape flat 7s, Elemental Wrath flat 7s, Supreme Display of Talent flat 120s.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].d now name the abilities and carry the numbers.

edits.before: - Qiyana Audacity: matchup-defining — Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E-Q stun package for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: From levels 3-6 you keep the same script: your Q and passive stacks whittle her down while she has to gamble on a terrain-empowered E dash to even threaten you, and Pillar's stun lets you punish that dash hard. At 6, Pyroclasm gives you a long-range execute/root that can catch her mid-combo or punish a bad flash-engage, and since her Elementalist Draconic ultimate needs terrain too you actually have the safer level-6 spike here. She can look for jungler-assisted all-ins, but if you play with vision and hold cooldowns for her dash you come out ahead almost every time.
edits.after: From levels 3-6 you keep the same script: your poke and Blaze stacks whittle her down while she has to gamble on Audacity to even threaten you, and Sear stunning an ablaze target punishes that dash hard. At 6, Pyroclasm bounces up to five times and slows anything already ablaze, catching her mid-combo or punishing a bad flash-engage, and since Supreme Display of Talent needs an element too you have the safer level-6 spike here. She can look for jungler-assisted all-ins, but if you play with vision and hold cooldowns for her dash you come out ahead almost every time.
